paper_title: CodeRAG-Bench Can Retrieval Augment Code Generation
caption: Performance with different chunking sizes.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and an unspecified performance metric across four different data sources. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens," has a linear scale, spans from 200 to 900, and is marked at intervals of 200. The y-axis is unlabeled, has a linear scale, ranges from 10 to 40, and is marked at intervals of 10. Four lines are plotted: "Tutorials" in blue with a solid line and circle markers, starting at approximately 23 and increasing to around 30 at 800 tokens before slightly decreasing to about 29 at 900 tokens; "Library Documentation" in red with a solid line and circle markers, beginning at roughly 24, rising to about 31 at 800 tokens, and then dropping to approximately 28 at 900 tokens; "StackOverflow posts" in orange with a solid line and circle markers, commencing at around 32, gradually decreasing to about 21 at 700 tokens, and then sharply declining to approximately 12 at 900 tokens; "Github files" in green with a solid line and circle markers, starting at about 29, increasing to roughly 32 at 800 tokens, and then decreasing to approximately 28 at 900 tokens.
